title: Titles
summary: How to earn and choose 77 cosmetic titles for slaying, dragons, Classic dungeon completion, skills and adventures.
body:
Not released. This is the planned earned-title catalog. These new titles and #titles are unavailable until the server release is activated.

Choosing your title

Titles are cosmetic, permanent unlocks for one character. They give no stats, experience, loot or combat bonuses, and do not transfer to other characters. Once released, open the native Titles window to choose an earned prefix or suffix; choosing a title does not consume it. You may change or clear it. New awards never replace your currently selected title.

Use #titles or #titles 2 to check six requirements per page. Opening the Titles window or using #titles also checks existing dungeon, story and skill progress. Qualifying kills and a skill reaching its cap award their titles automatically. Level-50 and dungeon/story milestones are reconciled when you open the list.

Combat credit

New slayer counters start when this feature is enabled. Defeat naturally spawned enemies that are not gray to your character. The credited killer and their current group or raid members can each count the kill if alive, connected and within 200 game units in the same zone instance. A pet or swarm-pet victory follows native owner credit. Pets, charmed victims, merchants, chests, scripted campaign actors and GM accounts do not count. There is no requirement to land the final blow personally.

Undead means the server undead, summoned-undead and vampire body types; giants include raid giants; dragons include all four server dragon body types. Appearance alone does not determine a slayer family. Named victory titles require the exact named encounter in its home zone. Earlier personal Keeper boss credit for Nagafen, Vox or the Fear dracoliche can qualify; it does not create historical slayer totals.

What completing Classic means

Conqueror of Classic requires a personal full Raid clear in every dungeon below. Each run must record your credit for all required bosses. Entering a run, another member finishing it or killing only its last boss is insufficient. Grind clears qualify for Dungeon Delver but do not satisfy Classic conquest. Saved full-clear history counts; older Plane of Hate clears and the current Hate layout count as one dungeon. Chapterhouse and Ashen Compact are separate adventures and do not replace a Classic dungeon. This is Nightcap’s 21-dungeon completion checklist, not every quest, item or NPC in the expansion. Later expansion completion titles will receive separate checklists when those releases are designed.

  • Befallen
  • Estate of Unrest
  • High Keep
  • Najena
  • Cazic-Thule
  • Permafrost
  • Nagafen's Lair
  • Blackburrow
  • Crushbone

  • Upper Guk

  • Castle Mistmoore
  • Kedge Keep
  • Splitpaw
  • The Hole
  • Qeynos Catacombs
  • Plane of Fear
  • Plane of Hate
  • Plane of Sky

Skill mastery

Be level 50 or higher and reach the highest legal level-50 raw skill cap among your currently held classes. A cap of zero never qualifies. A low-level cap, equipment modifiers and temporary skill bonuses do not qualify. Existing racial, class, tradeskill advancement and specialization rules remain unchanged. Master Artisan needs all seven listed crafts at their legal caps together. Different builds can have different legal caps; the in-game progress command shows yours. Unlocks remain after leveling, changing classes or releasing a class.
